module TopModule (
    input  logic        clk,
    input  logic        load,
    input  logic [511:0] data,
    output logic [511:0] q
);

    always_ff @(posedge clk) begin
        if (load) begin
            q <= data;
        end else begin
            q <= ({1'b0, q[511:1]} ^ {q[510:0], 1'b0});
        end
    end

endmodule
